articles.title: affaan-m/ECC
articles.excerpt: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
articles.summary: 面向 AI 编码代理的 harness 性能优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等工具补上技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发流程。核心是让代理在长任务中保持上下文、复用经验并受安全约束，适合重度依赖编码代理的团队搭建可复用的代理能力层。

articles.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
articles.excerpt: A framework for building agentic apps
articles.summary: 用于构建 agentic 应用的框架，把代理能力作为应用的原生组成，而非外挂插件。开发者可基于它组织工具调用、状态与交互流程，适合需要让 LLM 代理直接驱动产品逻辑的团队，用较少胶水代码搭建端到端的智能应用。

articles.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
articles.excerpt: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
articles.summary: Cloudflare 出品的编码代理技能，用于执行多阶段安全审计：代理按流程逐层排查代码，产出可被机器读取、且经过独立验证的审计结论。适合把安全审计自动化接入 CI 或代理工作流的团队，降低人工复核成本并提升结论可信度。

articles.title: trycua/cua
articles.excerpt: Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
articles.summary: 面向 computer-use 的开源基础设施，提供跨操作系统的驱动与设备集群管理，并附带用于训练、评估和数据生成的基准。目标是让代理像人一样操作图形界面，可扩展到成规模的虚拟机或设备机群，适合做 GUI 代理训练与评测的团队。

articles.title: anthropics/financial-services
articles.summary: Anthropic 官方仓库，方向为金融服务行业的 Claude 落地。当前未提供项目描述，具体内容需进仓库确认，推测包含面向金融场景的示例、参考实现或集成方案，适合金融机构开发者与 AI 工程团队参考。

articles.title: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx
articles.excerpt: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
articles.summary: 社区维护的文档管理系统，把纸质与电子文档扫描后统一索引、归档，支持全文检索、标签与自动分类。可自托管部署，替代堆积的文件夹与商业 DMS，适合个人、家庭和中小团队做长期的文档数字化与合规存档。

articles.title: anthropics/claude-code
articles.excerpt: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
articles.summary: Anthropic 的终端代理式编码工具，能读取并理解代码库，自动执行常规任务、解释复杂代码、处理 git 工作流。运行在命令行中，适合希望在现有终端与编辑器环境里直接获得代理辅助的开发者，减少重复性劳动。

articles.title: mihail911/modern-software-dev-assignments
articles.excerpt: Assignments for CS146S: The Modern Software Dev (Stanford University Fall 2026/2025)
articles.summary: 斯坦福 CS146S《现代软件开发》课程的作业仓库，内容围绕当代工程实践，覆盖 AI 辅助编码、版本控制与协作流程等主题。适合想按名校课程节奏自学现代开发工具链的学生与开发者，可对照讲义动手完成练习。

articles.title: higgsfield-ai/higgsfield
articles.excerpt: Fault-tolerant, highly scalable GPU orchestration, and a machine learning framework designed for training models with billions to trillions of parameters
articles.summary: 面向超大规模模型训练的 GPU 编排与机器学习框架，强调容错与高可扩展性，支持参数量从十亿到万亿级的模型训练。解决大规模集群中的任务调度、故障恢复与资源利用问题，适合自建训练集群的 AI 研究团队与企业。

articles.title: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
articles.excerpt: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
articles.summary: 开源的市场行情平台，作为昂贵商业行情工具的替代方案，支持实时价格追踪、自定义提醒和公司基本面洞察。由社区公开构建、永久免费，适合个人投资者、量化爱好者以及想自建行情看板的小团队使用。

articles.title: coder/coder
articles.excerpt: Secure environments for developers and their agents
articles.summary: 为开发者及其 AI 代理提供安全、可复现的开发环境，把工作区从本地机器搬到集中管理的基础设施上，按需创建、自动回收。适合需要统一环境配置、控制源码访问并降低安全风险的企业工程团队。

articles.title: vercel-labs/json-render
articles.excerpt: The Generative UI framework
articles.summary: Vercel Labs 出品的生成式 UI 框架，以 JSON 描述界面结构，再由模型动态生成渲染结果。适合构建由 LLM 实时决定界面内容的应用，例如动态表单、数据看板，以及代理对话过程中即时生成的可交互组件。

articles.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
articles.excerpt: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
articles.summary: 面向 AI 编码代理的生产级工程技能集合，把代码审查、测试、性能优化等成熟实践整理成代理可调用的技能模块。适合想让编码代理遵循真实工程规范、而不是仅追求代码跑通的开发者与团队。

articles.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB

articles.excerpt: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

articles.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)
articles.excerpt: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.

articles.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
articles.excerpt: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. articles.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora

articles.title: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
articles.excerpt: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. articles.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache

articles.title: From all-or-nothing to task-based OAuth consent
